question: Which of the following players is NOT a part of the Indian cricket team in ICC World Cup 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Yuvraj Singh**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Yuvraj Singh was a prominent Indian cricketer who played a crucial role in India's 2011 World Cup victory.
 
• However, he was not selected for the 2019 World Cup squad.
 
• The Indian team for the 2019 World Cup was selected based on various factors such as recent form, fitness, and team balance.
 
• While Yuvraj Singh had made significant contributions to Indian cricket, the selectors opted for other players who were deemed more suitable for the specific conditions and requirements of the tournament.
